label: Weapon
description: Named swords, polearms, axes, bows, firearms, fighting implements, and fantasy or science-fiction weapons.
notes: Weapon types and recognizable named forms belong here; object.armor owns shields and protective equipment. Values use articles or natural plurals and avoid brands, model numbers, and fixed decorative finishes. The existing type chips are retained: spear includes bladed polearms, bow includes crossbows, and other includes maces, flails, and throwing weapons. Genre tags restrict visibly supernatural and speculative weapons, while historical weapons remain available as contemporary replicas or display pieces.
